schema: A verdict is {refused: CodeLinkRefusal name} or a program: {program: text}, {programCodeUnits: UTF-16 code units}, {programCase: the encoder case whose source it is}, or {programLength, programSha256: SHA-256 of the UTF-16LE code units}. A base is an encoder case and its payload. truncations: one letter for each proper prefix length from 1 (D Damaged, N NotCanonical, S SourceTooLong, K accepted, then listed in accepted by length; . not sampled). mutations: the character at a position replaced by to, or deleted when to is null. cases: input (or inputCodeUnits) is a payload of the format format, or a link when isLink, with linkFormat and linkPayload what TryGetPayload gives (null when it is false).
